🟣 AIR QUALITY ALERT | DELHI 🟣 ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ CPCB NAQI Status: 342 (VERY POOR) Primary Hazard: PM2.5 Sub-Indices: PM25: 342 | PM10: 260 | NO2: 115 | SO2: 45 📈 24h–72h Forecast Outlook: • Projected Peak: 388 AQI • Peak Period: Tomorrow 07:00 AM (Winter Inversion Peak) 🩺 Public Health Advisory:
Respiratory illness expected on prolonged exposure. Avoid all morning outdoor exertion.
🛡️ Recommended Precautionary Actions: • Wear certified N95/FFP2 respirators when stepping outdoors. • Seal windows during early morning and late evening inversion hours. • Sensitive individuals (asthma, cardiac, elderly) must avoid outdoor workouts. • Operate indoor HEPA air filtration if available. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ Broadcasted by Air Quality Forecasting System (@khushiyadav35)
